message: No detected input validation: The filename received from the POST request JSON is used directly without any validation of structure, type, allowed characters, or path traversal checks.

No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data sources (URLs, S3, HuggingFace, etc.) are fetched in this pipeline stage; data is acquired via local recording or user-supplied filename, with no integrity or authenticity checks.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, expected-set validation, or label-noise detection tool is used anywhere in the data preparation flow.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering applied to training samples or incoming audio data.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads serialized models via pickle.load and torch (e.g., stacked_model_filepath) without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before loading.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, validates expected label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used in any part of the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no isolation of a held-out test set from training data, no hashing or signing of evaluation data, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The filename from the JSON request body is used directly without any validation, sanitization, or schema checking before being passed to the model prediction function.

No detected output bounds checks: The prediction result from stacked_em.predict() is returned directly as predicts[0] with no NaN checks, probability bounds validation, or threshold-based sanity checks.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an audio classification model (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable to this pipeline.
